title: Auth
description: Sign-ins, sign-ups, errors, processing time, requests and traffic for Auth, laid out like Supabase Studio's Auth report, with Auth's own email and database metrics below.

panels.title: Sign In Attempts
panels.description: Requests to Auth's token endpoint, by result. The endpoint handles every sign-in type, including token refreshes, and the metric does not record the type. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Sign Ups
panels.description: Successful requests to Auth's sign-up endpoint. When email confirmation is on, which is the default, a sign-up counts here before the user confirms the email address. Users who sign up through an OAuth provider, SSO or an invite are not counted. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Password Reset Requests
panels.description: Successful requests to Auth's password recovery endpoint. Auth also answers 200 for an email address that has no account, so those requests count here too. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: API Gateway Auth Errors
panels.description: Responses from Auth with a 4xx or 5xx status code, one series for each status code. The 401 and 403 responses the gateway returns itself never reach Auth, so they are not counted here. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Auth Errors by Route
panels.description: Responses from Auth with a 4xx or 5xx status code, one series for each Auth endpoint. Studio shows Auth's error codes instead, which only appear in the responses. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Sign In Processing Time
panels.description: Time Auth took to answer successful requests to its token endpoint. Average is the measure Studio shows, and p50, p95 and p99 are percentiles. Token refreshes are included and are faster than a password check.

panels.title: Sign Up Processing Time
panels.description: Time Auth took to answer successful requests to its sign-up endpoint. Average is the measure Studio shows, and p50, p95 and p99 are percentiles.

panels.title: Total Requests
panels.description: Requests that reached Auth through the gateway. Requests the gateway rejected itself are not counted here. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Response Errors
panels.description: Responses from Auth with a 4xx or 5xx status code. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Response Speed
panels.description: Time from the gateway sending a request to Auth until Auth's response is complete, in milliseconds. Average is the measure Studio shows, and p95 is the 95th percentile. Requests the gateway rejected itself are left out because they never reach Auth.

panels.title: Network Traffic
panels.description: Bytes between the gateway and Auth. Ingress, above the axis, is what the gateway sent to Auth, which is the requests. Egress, below the axis, is what Auth sent back, which is the responses. Both count headers as well as bodies. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Emails
panels.description: Emails Auth tried to send, such as confirmations, magic links and password resets, and the attempts that failed. Failed is part of Attempted, not an addition to it. A failure usually means the SMTP server refused the message or could not be reached. Studio has no chart for this. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Email Rate Limit Hits
panels.description: Requests Auth refused because they went over the email rate limit, one series for each endpoint. Studio has no chart for this. The chart shows the rate per second, and the legend shows the total for the selected time range.

panels.title: Database Query Time
panels.description: Time Auth's queries to Postgres took, in milliseconds. Average is the mean over all queries, and p95 is the 95th percentile. Studio has no chart for this.
